score_reasons.quality: Tweet body Chinese text and poster headline render crisply with correct glyphs; however the bottom UI action row contains two visibly malformed Chinese labels (the character after 转 is wrong, and the two-character label before 32.4M is garbled), the bookmark icon in the poster stats row is an odd rectangular glyph rather than a bookmark ribbon, and the X avatar logo is off-brand blue-on-black. No structural/anatomy defects.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Clean card layout with clear hierarchy; the embedded dark poster has convincing depth with blue circuit-line perspective and a disciplined black/white/blue palette; subtitle placement is balanced. The light UI around the dark poster creates acceptable contrast, though overall it reads generic.
score_reasons.alignment: Several explicit requirements missed: the tweet interface is LIGHT mode, not the required dark mode; canvas is 2:3 (1664x2496), not the required 3:4; 收藏 34K is shown plain, not lit (点赞 298K is correctly lit red); an extra inconsistent gray handle 'birtipil' appears under @OpenAI. On the plus side, all required copy is present verbatim: the four Chinese body sentences, the search line, poster title Ailln AI, subtitle, and all five engagement figures with correct values.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: The X UI skeleton is plausible (display name, blue verified check, menu dots, K/M stat formatting, heart = likes), but fidelity breaks down: the gray handle contradicts the @OpenAI account, the bottom action row omits like/bookmark and carries garbled Chinese labels, and the logo colors deviate from the real brand mark.
score_reasons.creative_generation: The embedded poster executes the 'dark official hacker' brief well: minimal typography, neon circuit cityscape, restrained accent color; integrating it as a media attachment inside a believable post shell shows good compositional thinking. Deduction because the surrounding UI details undermine the illusion.
